I originally wrote a 5 star review based on the fact that it fit my LG MODEL LSC27925ST fridge perfectly and I was thrilled to find a replacement for the fraction of the cost. The water seemed to look clear and taste fine after I dumped about 4 gallons like you're supposed too.

Unfortunately, after a day or two the water started to taste foul, even my kids noticed. It's been about two weeks now and it's not going away. Unfiltered tap water tastes better than what we have coming out of the fridge now. I never had that problem with the LG filter. I'm throwing this one away and buying an LG one. This one is a fraction of the cost but the water is almost undrinkable. You get what you paid for. I learned my lesson, buying only LG replacements from now on.

Bought the PerfectPure Water Filter in 08/2016 and about to replace it. I used a HM digital water quality tester Model TDS-EZ also bought from amazon. First installed the water quality range was from 120-123ppm and at 6 months the water quality level is still at 120-123ppm at room temp. My house tap water is at 140-143ppm at room temp. My Britta water filter ranges 49-52ppm at room temp. PerfectPure Water filter was OK, water tasted fine. My wife did bump the filter once that wiggled it loose enough to leak a little until i tightened it back in. I will be looking at other water filters for my LG fridge. This is the second none LG brand water filter i've used. This was better than the LG brand filter.
